name: codex-usage-lens
description: Per-turn token usage buttons and a compact session meter for Codex Desktop.

interface.shortDescription: See each turn's token usage without leaving your conversation.
interface.longDescription: Local per-turn token usage buttons. After you trust the Windows session hooks, the helper restores automatically. An existing local connection is required for buttons; manual activation can prepare a one-time reopen. No shortcuts or login entries are added by default.
